SSO SOC 2

Security at Acme

Data protection

All customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256. Data in transit is protected with TLS 1.2 or higher.

Encryption keys are stored in a hardware security module and rotated every year.

Identity and access

  • We require multi-factor authentication for all employees who access production.
  • Access follows the principle of least privilege and is reviewed every quarter.
  • We do not currently support SAML single sign-on on the Free plan.

Compliance

Acme has a SOC 2 Type II report and is ISO 27001 certified.

Testing

An independent firm performs a penetration test at least once a year.

Report a vulnerability through our bug bounty program on HackerOne.

Resilience

Customer data is backed up daily and backups are tested twice a year.
